# Repository configuration

- Owner: JosephHill04
- Name: jmpread
- Visibility: Public (confirmed by the owner)
- Description: Read JMP (.jmp) data tables directly in R, without Python or a JMP installation.
- Default branch: main
- License: MIT, with upstream MIT notices retained
- Topics: r, r-package, jmp, data-import, statistical-data, binary-parser
- Issues: enabled
- Wiki: disabled (README, help and vignette cover documentation)
- Projects and Discussions: disabled initially
- Allow squash merging; delete merged branches automatically
- Automated checks: R CMD check on Windows/macOS/Linux and R-release/R-devel

Use the package directory as the repository root; DESCRIPTION must be at its
top level. Do not upload the surrounding coursework directory, private exports,
development libraries or the Python reference checkout.

The source is experimental. Publishing this repository is not a CRAN release.
Repository settings in this file are intended settings until applied and verified
on GitHub. Check the repository page and Actions tab after the initial upload.
